contract_plain_english: In one spatial dimension, the homogeneous first-order constant-coefficient linear system for an unknown real m-component field q(x,t), with q : R × R → R^m and a constant real m × m matrix A, is written q_t(x,t) + A q_x(x,t) = 0. Subscripts mean partial derivatives in time and space. This introduces the equation to be satisfied; it neither asserts that arbitrary q satisfies it nor supplies an existence or uniqueness theorem. The displayed derivative notation suggests a classical pointwise reading, but regularity and explicit quantifier scope are not specified. Additional properties of A are needed for hyperbolicity.
